attributes.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
attributes.description: A quintessential African coffee, Yirgacheffe is celebrated for its bright, clean flavor profile. Expect vibrant notes of lemon and jasmine with a distinct floral aroma and a light-to-medium body. Perfect for pour-over brewing.

attributes.name: Colombia Nariño
attributes.description: Grown in the high-altitude volcanic soils of southwestern Colombia, this roast offers a smooth, balanced cup with a nutty sweetness and hints of dark chocolate. It features a crisp acidity that finishes beautifully.

attributes.name: French Roast Coffee
attributes.description: Our darkest roast for those who love a bold, smoky flavor. The beans are roasted until they reach a deep chocolate brown with a shimmering coat of oil, resulting in a low-acid cup with intense charred notes.

attributes.name: Sumatra Mandheling
attributes.description: Hailing from the Indonesian island of Sumatra, this bean is famous for its earthy, complex character. It boasts a heavy body, low acidity, and deep notes of cedar, sweet tobacco, and spice.

attributes.name: Hazelnut Specialty
attributes.description: An aromatic treat featuring our premium medium roast infused with the creamy, toasted flavor of wild hazelnuts. A crowd favorite that brings a warm, comforting fragrance to your kitchen every morning.

attributes.name: Guatemala Antigua
attributes.description: Produced in the rich volcanic soil surrounding the city of Antigua, this coffee is known for its elegant acidity and spicy, smoky undertones wrapped in a rich cocoa sweetness.

attributes.name: Kenya AA
attributes.description: The 'AA' designation refers to the largest bean size available in Kenya. This coffee is renowned for its potent sweetness and bold fruit flavors, reminiscent of blackcurrant and grapefruit.

attributes.name: Signature Espresso Blend
attributes.description: A carefully crafted blend of Latin American and Asia-Pacific beans, roasted specifically to stand up to high-pressure extraction. It produces a thick crema and notes of molasses and caramel.

attributes.name: Brazil Santos
attributes.description: A smooth, low-acid coffee known for its creamy body. This medium roast features distinct notes of milk chocolate and roasted nuts, making it an incredibly approachable daily drinker.

attributes.name: Costa Rica Tarrazú
attributes.description: Grown in the volcanic soil of the Tarrazú region, this light roast is wonderfully bright. Expect a crisp acidity with sweet honey undertones and a refreshing citrus finish.

attributes.name: Tanzania Peaberry
attributes.description: A unique bean where only one seed develops inside the cherry. This results in a concentrated flavor profile featuring wine-like acidity, deep berry notes, and a complex, spicy aroma.
